Match their SAME ARTIST: bold slightly varied warm-black contours, thinner deliberate interior lines, flat matte colours, one clean hard-edged cel-shadow per major form, small flat highlights only. Simple expressive feline faces, large eyes, broad short muzzles, compact oversized heads, small round torsos, very short feline limbs and rounded grouped paws. Same level of finish and line weight as the references, not more realistic or more detailed. Fur is a few silhouette tufts or grouped curls, never individual strands. Wood, cloth, stone, water and metal are flat graphic shapes. No painterly brushwork, grain, hatching, gradients, bloom, 3D rendering, glossy surfaces or realistic reflections.
Composition: square 1024x1024 illustration, full character with a distinct action silhouette; large face and both eyes clearly readable in the upper-middle of the square, with the important prop directly below the face. Allow clean margins at upper left and upper right for the game's overlaid element and Power badges. Nothing cropped at the feet, ears or tail. Background is shallow and sparse, cream/element-colour ground plus one broad graphic emblem and up to three simplified environmental motifs. No busy scenery or distant figures.
Anatomy gate: exactly one feline head, one torso, one tail, TWO forelegs and TWO hind legs. Each foreleg traces continuously from shoulder to its prop-holding paw; a prop-holding foreleg replaces, never supplements, a planted front leg. Each hind leg traces from its haunch to one rear paw. Four coherent limbs total. Simple mitten-like cat paws with at most three broad rounded toe groups, no human fingers, no extra thumbs, no floating hands or disconnected feet. Keep contacts and occlusions easy to read. No human-height bodies, human waist/hips, long arms or human shoes.

Subject: Megwyn Windwhistle, female Gust Rare Rally character. A compact cream Devon Rex court musician, very large expressive cat ears, short grouped curly fur, green eyes and a knowing playful expression. She wears a sage-green short puff-sleeved tunic, a forest-green short waistcoat with only a couple of broad embroidered leaf stitches, and a small brown belt pouch. One simple feather tucked behind an ear. No cape or scarf.
Action: seated sideways on a low simple stone, torso gently turned three-quarter toward the viewer, both green eyes visible, playing ONE carved wooden flute at her mouth. BOTH forepaws grip the SAME flute at two separated places; two short forelegs visibly attach to the shoulders. The flute is one continuous straight wooden tube with a few clear holes, no disconnected segments or duplicated instruments. Two hind paws are visible below her seated haunches, naturally supported by the stone. One tail curls around the seat independently of the feet. A green ribbon tied near the flute's far end and one pale cream/teal wind curve flow away from the instrument, avoiding her eyes and forelegs.
Palette/backdrop: sky-blue ground, one large soft-cream flat circle, olive/forest-green costume, teal wind accents. Only a low grassy roadside edge, the seat stone, and two windblown seed heads; no castle, background animals or silhouettes. Cheerful, clever medieval adventure, readable at small card size.
